description: MMS gate: run the inline esm-spec 6.6 tests of problems/latlon_diffusion_zonal_periodic.esm (model ZonalDiffusion, test mms_zonal_diffusion_decay) at the problem's default resolution (NLON=144, NLAT edge-bound to 5) through each binding's official simulation pathway. The assertions and their tolerances live in the problem file itself; this manifest only routes the runners.

scope_excluded.go: rewrite-only port; no makearray lowering / simulator
scope_excluded.typescript: rewrite-only port; no makearray lowering / simulator

python._doc: Pinned so Python temporal truncation is negligible against the spatial goldens: LSODA at 1e-12/1e-14 handles the stiff diffusion sweep and agrees with the Julia Tsit5 reference to well under the error_vs_golden tolerance on every resolution, where a loose explicit RK method would leave a temporal residue comparable to the spatial error.

Deterministic LSODA/RK45-vs-Tsit5 integrator-method disagreement on a floor-sensitive time-integrated functional: mms_zonal_diffusion_decay[2] rel 1.40e-07 / abs 1.35e-12 (ref 9.665243e-06). MEASURED from CI run 33272496703 (2026-08-29); the values are bit-stable across runs and the inline assertions pass at the problem-file tolerances, so only the cross-binding re-evaluation band is widened (10x headroom, decade-rounded). Re-tighten if the bindings ever pin the same integrator.
